attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012108874 (CC0): the pump hall's seven bays of tall three-light windows under geometric glazing between brick pilasters with stone caps, lintels and sills, the dark plinth, the east gable window, the one-storey link with the Pompstation entrance and sign, and the house with its white window pairs, eaves cornice and dormer, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and the municipal monument register (CC0). No pixels or meshes imported.
